objective: Implement the exact owner-accepted Essays local browser runtime and clean frontend from the bound DomainSpec v2 system ontology, using Whisper as lifecycle guidance and a stripped Milkdown core adapter.
outcomes: A pure TypeScript Essays domain runtime owns workspace, accepted intent and plan, exact draft revisions, stable block identities, addressable review, residue, and export eligibility.
One typed EssaysRuntimeInterface enforces expected-revision conflicts and separates browser persistence through an Essays-owned repository port.
A responsive React studio implements the intent-to-plan-to-draft-to-review-to-validation-to-export lifecycle without claiming Whisper invocation.
A project-owned React effect mounts and destroys only Milkdown core, CommonMark, history, and listener packages; the editor lazy-loads after the shell.
The Milkdown listener's settling period is visible and disables Save so fast interaction cannot admit stale editor state.
Local export contains exact accepted Markdown, stable blocks, review, residue, and publicationEffect none.
